spans.s:
Licking, tasting.
E.
लिह to taste, aff. ण.

n. (-नं)
Licking, tasting with the tongue.
E.
लिह to taste, to lick, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि)
Who or what licks, laps, tastes, &c.
E.
लिह to lick, घिनुण् aff.

m. (-नः)
Borax.
E.
लिह to lick, aff. इन.

mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं)
To be licked.
n. (-ह्यं)
1 The food or beverage of the gods, nectar, ambrosia.
2 Syrup, electuary.
E.
लिह to taste, क्यप् aff.
